reason: Readback caught a ledger-generation classification bug in v1: the structural-line heuristic treated source lines beginning with \item as NOT_MATHEMATICAL even when the same physical line contained a substantive theorem clause. v2 narrows that heuristic to item-only marker lines and records substantive item lines as mathematical.
mathematical_audit_change: none; the underlying clauses had been source-read and checked in the pass. This correction fixes only the persisted line-ledger classification.
rendered_pdf_page_mapping_note: PDF-page cross references use the source-pinned page map; screenshot-level glyph/source equivalence remains UNCHECKED because a screenshot-capable route to the private PDF was unavailable.
